operators.desc: change 1-4 events in slots 9-16, favour 13-16
bar 4 may rewrite slots 9-16
bar 8: rewrite 4-12 slots, end with >=4-sixteenth hole, <=3 lanes change
rotate a cell by +/-1 sixteenth (keep off-kick for bass)
rotate whole bar by 2/4/8 slots
remove 1 onset (space > notes)
add ghost (~35% vel) on an empty e/a
move 1 bass note +12 (only styles with octave share >0)
swap partner degree (b7<->5<->b3<->2) for one bar
change note lengths within bucket targets
velocity->filter accent pattern rotation (same notes, new groove)
mute one lane for 2/4/8 bars at a phrase boundary, never two lanes at once
LPF/HPF automation over 8/16/32/64 bars
switch one lane to 3/5/7-step loop for N bars
per-step probability 0.6-0.95 on ghosts/perc only (never kick/clap)
groove swing 50-56, hat swing 50-57 default 52, clap up to 63. A 62-66 switch is the Ellia/2-step option, not Gaskin.
+/-3-15 ms humanize on hats/perc/vox
optional: move a stab toward a bass rest. Not required.
1-bar dotted-1/8 delay throw on last stab/vox of phrase
replace cell with a sibling of same type (same density bucket)
thin a lane to half its onsets for 'reveal' bars
drop kick on beat 4 of bar 8 or full bar 16/32
vary hat decay/gate per step (groove from length)
swap one-shot in a lane from the same category of Melak's packs

hard_rules.rule: pitched notes stay in the minor/dorian set; Gaskin may add b2. Anything else is the wrong key.
bass on the kick stays at or under 28% (Gaskin 35%). Above that is a low-end clash and a hard reject.
every bar of every active lane has >=1 event unless the lane is in a planned mute/rest cell; never an all-silent bar; never kick+bass both absent outside a planned breakdown
no bar of any lane matches a reference transcription bar at >=0.9 pitch+rhythm similarity (tools/originality_check.py)

soft_rules.rule: bass onsets prefer e/and/a; up to 28% may sit on the kick
top-2 pitch time preferred at or above 63% (floor 58)
1-4 events in slots 9-16, favour 13-16. A back-half tendency, not the last 2-4 sixteenths only.
per-style preference, not a fail. References put about 25% of stabs in rests and about 50% on bass attacks.
one lane changes per 8 bars in LONG/UK MIN
prefer at least 25% silent bass slots; LIGHTLEAK shows a 3% floor
vox phrases start in back half of bars 4/8
octave moves 0-25%, either none or about 15-25%

notes: style_w are priors (0-1), multiply with label_style_weights of the user's chosen label flavour if any
inference=true means pattern is an abstraction/ESTIMATE not directly measured or quoted; see GENRE_KNOWLEDGE.md
ar_notes: Applied AR_REVIEW 2026-10-17. DX3N kept. Fuse, Hottrax and Solid Grooves weight 0.
Hard rejects are only wrong key, kick/bass clash above the cap, empty bars, and originality.
